cv_text:
BAGAS PRATAMA — Backend Engineer, 6 years.
EXPERIENCE: 2021-2026 Payments Platform Engineer. Owned a Go service handling 4k req/s; cut p99 latency from 420ms to 160ms. Designed a partitioned Postgres ledger of 180M rows and cut slow queries by 70%. Migrated 12 services to Kubernetes and halved CI build time.
SKILLS: Go (expert), Postgres, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, gRPC.
report_text: I once made our checkout faster. I looked at the code and found a slow part, then I changed it. After that the checkout was faster and the team was happy. It was a good project and I learned a lot about performance. I think it worked well.

PROJECT RUBRIC (score 1-5 where 5 = exceptional):
- Problem framing and constraints: 30%
- Technical depth and trade-offs discussed: 30%
- Evidence (measurements, benchmarks, post-mortems): 20%
- Communication quality and structure: 20%
